agent-toolkit-manifest.$schema: Canonical schema URI used to validate the installed toolkit manifest.
agent-toolkit-manifest.adapters: Harness-specific mappings from the portable toolkit to repository instruction files and skills.
agent-toolkit-manifest.adapters[].harness: Agent harness that consumes this adapter mapping.
agent-toolkit-manifest.adapters[].instructionTarget: Repository instruction file populated for the selected harness.
agent-toolkit-manifest.adapters[].path: Toolkit-relative path to the adapter instructions.
agent-toolkit-manifest.adapters[].skills: Toolkit skill directories made available through this harness adapter.
agent-toolkit-manifest.assets: Complete integrity-checked inventory of files shipped in the portable toolkit bundle.
agent-toolkit-manifest.assets[].mode: Portable Unix permission mode installed for the asset.
agent-toolkit-manifest.assets[].path: Bundle-relative location of the shipped asset.
agent-toolkit-manifest.assets[].sha256: SHA-256 digest used to verify the installed asset bytes.
agent-toolkit-manifest.bundleVersion: Version of the toolkit bundle layout and asset inventory.
agent-toolkit-manifest.cliCapabilities: Goobers CLI commands the toolkit requires or can use when available.
agent-toolkit-manifest.cliCapabilities.optional: CLI commands that enhance the toolkit but are not required for baseline operation.
agent-toolkit-manifest.cliCapabilities.required: CLI commands that must be present for the toolkit to operate.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions: Workflow DSL compatibility levels understood by this toolkit release.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].history: Chronological support-level transitions for this DSL version.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].history[].level: Support level that took effect at the associated toolkit release.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].history[].sinceVersion: Toolkit release where this support-level transition began.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].level: Current toolkit support level for this DSL version.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].replacement: Newer DSL version users should migrate to after this version is unsupported.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].unsupportedAfter: Planned release after which this DSL version is no longer supported.
agent-toolkit-manifest.dslVersions[].version: Workflow DSL version covered by this compatibility entry.
agent-toolkit-manifest.ownership: Boundary between release-owned toolkit files and user-owned repository instructions.
agent-toolkit-manifest.ownership.productRoot: Repository-relative root where release-owned toolkit assets are installed.
agent-toolkit-manifest.ownership.userOwnedInstructionFiles: Instruction files preserved as user-owned content during toolkit updates.
agent-toolkit-manifest.producer: Goobers build identity that assembled the toolkit bundle.
agent-toolkit-manifest.producer.commit: Source commit of the Goobers build that assembled the bundle.
agent-toolkit-manifest.producer.version: Release version of the Goobers build that assembled the bundle.
agent-toolkit-manifest.schemaVersion: Compatibility version of the toolkit-manifest payload.

candidate-findings-v1.causalCredit[].hasCohortData: Whether an experiment actually ran on this node, distinguishing a genuine identification failure from a node with no versioned changepoint or routed identity recorded at all.
candidate-findings-v1.findings: Deterministically selected telemetry anomalies proposed for follow-up work.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].error_class: Normalized error category for an error-signature finding, distinguishing findings that share a code but differ in error_class.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].flagged_runs: Run-journal references that provide evidence for the anomaly.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].kind: Stable anomaly category detected by the telemetry query.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].metrics: Measured values that caused the candidate to be selected.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].subject: Workflow, stage, gate, or error signature affected by the anomaly.
candidate-findings-v1.findings[].threshold: Configured comparison boundary that the measured value crossed.
candidate-findings-v1.noWork: Whether the query found no actionable telemetry candidates.
candidate-findings-v1.note: Human-readable explanation accompanying a no-work result or candidate set.
candidate-findings-v1.schema: Immutable wire identifier for the candidate-findings artifact version.

diagnostics.commit: Source commit of the Goobers build that produced the diagnostics.
diagnostics.counts: Aggregate error and warning totals for the validated input.
diagnostics.counts.errors: Number of error-severity findings that make validation unsuccessful.
diagnostics.counts.warnings: Number of warning-severity findings that do not alone fail validation.
diagnostics.findings: Ordered validation or lint findings with source locations.
diagnostics.findings[].code: Stable machine-readable identifier for the violated rule.
diagnostics.findings[].col: One-based source column for a text-located finding.
diagnostics.findings[].file: Input file containing the reported problem.
diagnostics.findings[].line: One-based source line for a text-located finding.
diagnostics.findings[].message: Human-readable explanation of the reported problem.
diagnostics.findings[].path: JSON Pointer locating the invalid value in the decoded document.
diagnostics.findings[].severity: Whether the finding is a validation error or advisory warning.
diagnostics.ok: Whether the input passed without any error-severity findings.
diagnostics.schemaVersion: Version of the machine-readable diagnostics envelope.
diagnostics.version: Goobers build version that produced the diagnostics.

features.commit: Source commit of the Goobers build whose DSL capabilities are listed.
features.dslVersion: Current workflow DSL version implemented by the producing build.
features.features: Version-filtered inventory of workflow DSL capabilities.
features.features[].name: Stable registry identifier for the DSL capability.
features.features[].sinceVersion: DSL version where the capability's current lifecycle state began.
features.features[].stability: Current lifecycle state of the capability in this build.
features.features[].used: Whether the inspected definition uses this capability.
features.schemaVersion: Version of the machine-readable feature-discovery envelope.
features.version: Goobers build version that produced the feature inventory.

journal-event.completeness[].artifacts: Number of artifacts produced by the declared branch.
journal-event.completeness[].branch: Numeric branch identifier assigned by declaration order.
journal-event.completeness[].name: Declared branch name represented by this completeness entry.
journal-event.completeness[].status: Terminal outcome recorded for the declared branch.
journal-event.externalRef.id: Provider-native identifier of the touched external object.
journal-event.externalRef.kind: Kind of external object touched, such as an issue or pull request.
journal-event.externalRef.provider: Provider that owns the touched external object.
journal-event.redaction.newDigest: Digest of the scrubbed replacement bytes after redaction.
journal-event.redaction.oldDigest: Digest of the original bytes replaced by redaction.
journal-event.redaction.target: Journal blob or field whose leaked content was replaced.
journal-event.externalRef.commitSha: Source control commit associated with the external reference.

journal-run.gaggle: Gaggle whose resolved configuration owns this run.
journal-run.inputs: Immutable, content-addressed input snapshots captured when the run started.
journal-run.inputs[].name: Stage-contract name used to address the captured input.
journal-run.inputs[].ref: Pointer to the immutable input snapshot in the run journal.
journal-run.inputs[].ref.digest: SHA-256 content digest of the stored input snapshot.
journal-run.inputs[].ref.mediaType: Optional media type describing the stored input bytes.
journal-run.inputs[].ref.path: Path to the input snapshot relative to the run directory.
journal-run.runControls.maxRepasses: Resolved maximum number of gate-directed repass cycles for this run.
journal-run.runControls.stalledRunTimeout: Resolved duration after which the run is considered stalled.
journal-run.runControls.maxRunDuration: Resolved maximum total wall-clock age of the run; omitted when disabled.
journal-run.schema: Versioned identifier for the pinned run identity contract.
journal-run.startedAt: Timestamp when the runner published the initialized run journal.
journal-run.trigger: Pinned trigger identity that caused the run to start.
journal-run.trigger.kind: Trigger mechanism that started the run.
journal-run.trigger.ref: Provider or scheduler reference identifying the triggering event.
journal-run.workflow: Name of the workflow definition pinned for this run.
journal-run.workflowVersion: Definition version the run must continue using through completion.
journal-run.contextPointers: Explicit continuation inputs; no ambient source context is copied.
journal-run.contextPointers[].integrity: Provenance grade of this context pointer.
journal-run.contextPointers[].runId: Source run identifier for the context.
journal-run.contextPointers[].artifact: Artifact reference for the context pointer.
journal-run.contextPointers[].branchName: Named branch path from the source run.
journal-run.contextPointers[].external.description: Human-readable description of the external reference.
journal-run.contextPointers[].branch: Numeric branch identifier from the source run.
journal-run.contextPointers[].artifact.mediaType: Optional media type describing the artifact bytes.
journal-run.contextPointers[].artifact.digest: SHA-256 content digest of the artifact.
journal-run.contextPointers[].artifact.path: Path to the artifact relative to the run directory.
journal-run.contextPointers[].external.uri: Provider URI identifying the external object.
journal-run.contextPointers[].name: Artifact or context name from the source run.
journal-run.contextPointers[]: Single context pointer for the continuation.
journal-run.contextPointers[].external: External reference for the context pointer.

remediation-brief.base: Target branch into which the selected pull request is proposed to merge.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures: Provider check failures and annotations gathered for remediation.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks: Failing or otherwise actionable provider checks at the inspected head.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks[].annotations: File and line annotations emitted by the provider check.
Last source line covered by the check annotation.
Provider severity assigned to the check annotation.
Detailed failure message emitted for the annotation.
Repository path associated with the check annotation.
First source line covered by the check annotation.
Short provider-supplied title for the annotation.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks[].conclusion: Provider conclusion recorded for the check run.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks[].name: Display name of the provider check.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks[].summary: Provider-supplied summary of the check failure.
remediation-brief.gatherCIFailures.checks[].url: Web URL for inspecting the provider check run.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext: Originating backlog issues whose requirements define the pull request's intended scope.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext.issues: Issue records linked to the selected pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext.issues[].body: Full issue request and acceptance criteria used as remediation context.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext.issues[].number: Provider issue number linked to the pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext.issues[].title: Issue title summarizing the requested change.
remediation-brief.gatherIssueContext.issues[].url: Web URL for the originating issue.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext: Selected pull request identity, pinned review verdict, and timeline evidence.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.baseSha: Base commit against which the gathered verdict and diff were evaluated.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.comments: Pull request timeline comments available to the remediation stage.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.comments[].author: Provider login that authored the timeline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.comments[].body: Complete timeline-comment text used as remediation evidence.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.comments[].createdAt: Timestamp when the timeline comment was created.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.comments[].url: Web URL linking directly to the timeline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.headSha: Pull request head commit whose state the gathered evidence describes.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict: Merge-review verdict pinned to the gathered pull request head and base, or null when unavailable.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.decision: Gate outcome that determines whether the pull request passes, fails, or needs changes.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.evidence: Journal artifact pointers supporting the evaluator's decision.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.findings: Actionable review findings that remediation must address individually.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.findings[].locat: File, selector, pull request, or other locus of the finding.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.findings[].messa: Specific defect or blocking condition identified by the evaluator.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.findings[].sever: Impact level assigned to the finding.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.rationale: Evaluator reasoning connecting the evidence to the decision.
remediation-brief.gatherPrContext.verdict.summary: Concise reviewer-facing statement of the verdict outcome.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads: Native reviews and inline discussion gathered from the pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments: Inline pull request comments, including current liveness metadata.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].aut: Provider login that authored the inline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].cre: Timestamp when the inline comment was created.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].dif: Diff context to which the inline comment was attached.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].inR: Provider comment identifier of the parent in a review thread.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].isO: Whether later commits moved the comment off the current diff.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].isR: Whether the review thread containing the comment is resolved.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].lin: Current-file line associated with the inline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].ori: Line in the original reviewed diff associated with the comment.
First line of the original multi-line review range.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].pat: Repository file discussed by the inline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].sid: Current diff side on which the comment is anchored.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].sta: First current-file line of a multi-line review range.
Current diff side for the start of a multi-line review range.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.inlineComments[].url: Web URL linking directly to the inline comment.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].author: Provider login that submitted the review.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].body: Top-level review text supplied with the submission.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].commitSha: Pull request commit inspected by the submitted review.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].state: Provider review state, such as approved or changes requested.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].submittedA: Timestamp when the review was submitted.
remediation-brief.gatherReviewThreads.reviews[].url: Web URL for the submitted review.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext: Open pull requests considered for overlap and sequencing.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests: Sibling pull requests with blocking and file-overlap evidence.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests[].bloc: Whether this sibling must land or close before the selected pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests[].head: Source branch of the sibling pull request.
Current source commit of the sibling pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests[].numb: Provider number identifying the sibling pull request.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests[].over: Repository paths changed by both the sibling and selected pull requests.
remediation-brief.gatherSiblingContext.pullRequests[].reas: Human-readable explanation of the sibling's sequencing relationship.
remediation-brief.hasFailingCI: String-valued gate input indicating whether actionable checks are failing.
remediation-brief.hasSubstantiveFindings: String-valued gate input indicating whether the pinned verdict has actionable findings.
remediation-brief.head: Source branch of the selected pull request.
remediation-brief.isBehindBase: Whether the selected head omits commits currently present on the base branch.
remediation-brief.schema: Immutable wire identifier for this remediation-brief version.
remediation-brief.selectedNumber: Provider number identifying the pull request selected for remediation.
remediation-brief.workspaceBranch: Local branch the runner checks out for remediation work.

result.artifacts: Content-addressed artifact pointers produced for downstream stages.
result.error: Structured failure detail required when the stage status is failure.
result.error.code: Stable machine-readable classifier for the stage failure.
result.error.message: Human-readable detail explaining the stage failure.
result.error.retryable: Whether orchestration may safely attempt the failed work again.
result.metrics: Numeric measurements reported by the stage for telemetry.
result.status: Runner outcome controlling success, failure, blocking, or no-work behavior.
result.summary: Concise human-readable account of the stage outcome.

verdict.decision: Gate outcome that selects the next workflow branch.
verdict.evidence: Journal artifact pointers supporting the evaluator's decision.
verdict.findings: Actionable defects or conditions discovered by the evaluator.
verdict.findings[].location: File, selector, pull request, or other locus of the finding.
verdict.findings[].message: Specific defect or blocking condition identified by the evaluator.
verdict.findings[].severity: Impact level assigned to the finding.
verdict.rationale: Evaluator reasoning connecting evidence to the selected decision.
verdict.summary: Concise reviewer-facing statement of the verdict outcome.
